title: Sharpodonties and Black Wine
subtitle: A couple of gold coins, a severed finger, and a great deal of wine.

trails.title: Wall Street Journal
trails.description: Critters are everywhere. Though they are annoying and hard to catch, specialized pawnshops offer to buy them at a decent price. Critters are divided into the following varieties. Which one did you run into?

content.text: An advertisement from the ads page of Wall Street Journal.

Come to C.C Critter Pawnshop to make extra money!
TEL: 847-6861XXX

Are the cunning, ubiquitous critters annoying you again? Don't take that as bad news, because if you have a critter, you just found yourself enough money to pay your rent! We offer the best, the most precise, and the most honest pricing options you'll ever find! Our shop will buy any critters from the cheapest Carbuncles to the expensive yet delicious Rubberados that keep diners bouncing about! C.C swears on its name that every critter we buy will be treated like a family in compliance with internationally recognized standards of humane treatment!

items.text: Sharpodonties and Black Wine

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Even the tree hole is not safe enough ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... We should go. I will carry it with me along the way.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But Regulus ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hm? What's that worried look?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Come on, Sonetto gave me a floppy disk. I'll reach the quarter 100% safe!
Don't take too long.

branch.speaker: Regulus
branch.text: I know. It's not very often I've seen you like that.

items.text: Run if you can't win.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I gotta split then! This is a free trip. I'll definitely enjoy myself. Ha-ha! ♪

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Let's get ready to move.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The mission is in the underground parking at No. 2122 Lincoln Park Street, two blocks away from us. We still have plenty of time ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Can ... could we go there by bus?
Sure. Enjoy the scenery.
items.edge_label: 没问题，好好欣赏风景吧

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Oh ... it's so cold here. This APPLe is getting frosty.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Really? I seem to feel nothing. It's actually kind of warm, compared to our routine training at low temperatures.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: According to the intelligence, now it's still one hour before the incident. Hmm ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: So this is the distance from the entrance to the wall, and here should also be marked ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: What you're depicting in the air ... Is that the reconstruction of the victims' position?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes, I reconstructed to actual scale. In this way I can calculate the position that can provide cover without hindering us from joining the battle in time.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: For anything that may cost others' lives, I want to be as cautious as possible. What if ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Huh. No, never mind. I am not worried about my own life. I am just ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's fine.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: They won't know.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Shh ...! Someone's here. Two human drunks!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't let them wander around. It's too dangerous here! The gang fight will definitely hurt them.
Stun them first.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: How's it going?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Skin damage: less than or equal to five millimeters. No visceral damage or psychube fluctuation found for the moment. Conclusion: the injuries meet the requirements of Emergency Defense Code of St. Pavlov Foundation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It will probably take some time for them to wake up. Hide them under the car first.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We don't have much time. Let's hurry to the hidden position. ... Mr. APPLe, why are you a little upset?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: ... This APPLe found a pack of sharpodonties in their pocket, and a child's finger ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: ... Which are the currencies that only used by arcanists.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Maybe ... that's just ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: It’s 1929, a year full of racial discrimination.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... This is also the reason why we need to stop the next tragedy. For the peace of all mankind.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Outside the silent underground parking, a piercing sound of brakes cut through.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There're still 30 minutes. Who's coming early ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Pap, pap, pap.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Gunshots?! Wha ...? But the arcanists haven't got here ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Damn it. Let's go!
TO BE CONTINUED…
